visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown hair sits in a brightly lit indoor space wearing a red tank top and denim shorts. A digital filter is applied to her face, magnifying her mouth and adding thick white eyebrows. She looks at the camera with a neutral expression. (2) The woman points her finger forward and her mouth opens extremely wide as part of a laughter animation. Her body shakes slightly while pointing. The filter maintains the large red lips and white brows. (3) The scene cuts and she is holding a white spray bottle. Her eyebrows change to a thick black, angry shape via the filter. She grimaces and makes rhythmic movements while looking down at the bottle. (4) She is seen in profile against a patterned glass window, using a white tissue to wipe the surface. Her eyebrows are now huge black rectangles. Her mouth is wide open in a large smile while she makes wiping motions. (5) She holds a large red kettle in both hands. The filter adds giant ears and a bright red nose to her face. In the background, an older man in a red polo shirt is visible sitting at a table with various items.
